feeds.title: Phired Up
feeds.description: The Phired Up Blog provides Thought Leadership and Intellectual Insights on building a Campus Fraternity. Phired Up company that delivers relationship-focused, data-driven, results-producing Technology, Education, and Strategy solutions for every aspect of the pre-member experience from first impression through initiation.

feeds.title: TheSororityLife Blog
feeds.description: Learn more about sorority recruitment, membership, and benefits of sisterhood in The Sorority Life Blog Presented by the National Panhellenic Conference, thesororitylife.com is a web-based comprehensive resource that assists and informs college freshwomen in connecting to a Sisterhood or Sorority of their choice.

feeds.title: Black Greek 101
feeds.description: Black Greek 101 blog is dedicated to providing information about the Black Greek Life community. The author is an active and diamond-life member of Delta Sigma Theta Sorority Inc. and discusses everything from Recruitment, Rushing Season to National Conventions and many more helpful insights.

feeds.title: Fraternity & Sorority Life Blog
feeds.description: Fraternity & Sorority Life Blog offers news and announcements to students on the Latest activities of the Office of Fraternity and Sorority Life at the University of Oregon. Learn expert advice on how to navigate your sorority and fraternity life and create memorable college life experiences.

feeds.title: Lehigh Greek Community
feeds.description: The official blog for the Lehigh Greek Community. Stay updated on the latest events and programs organized by the community along with news, stories, and motivation. The Lehigh University Greek Community is home to over 1,400 students and 22 fraternities and sororities.

feeds.title: Greek Life Store Blog
feeds.description: Greeklife.store is a licensed seller of Fraternity, Sorority, and university flags, iPhone cases, business card holders, coasters, and many other customized items. Check out our blog updates advising on the basics of Joining, Pledging, and Being part of a Sorority. We share crucial tips and ideas that will help you a long way along your college life.

feeds.title: Fraternity History & More
feeds.description: Fraternity/Sorority Historian Fran Becque, Ph.D., shares stories connecting the past to the present and the future. Learn about the rich past and intricate histories of GLO's (Greek Letter Organizations) and Women's Fraternities and their notable members in these blog articles.

feeds.title: Her Sorority Journey Blog
feeds.description: I'm Cassie, a sorority advocate & community enthusiast. I founded Her Sorority Journey in March 2020 to support members through the unique & ever-evolving challenges in the sorority experience. Stay in the loop with today's sorority woman & her journey through our weekly posts here.

feeds.title: The New York Times » Fraternities and Sororities
feeds.description: This column features the latest stories covering Fraternities and Sororities, Events, Hazing crimes, Greek Life, and related topics across American universities. Founded in 1851, The New York Times is a global media organization that offers subscriptions for its online and hard-copy daily newspapers.

feeds.title: University of Georgia | Greek Life
feeds.description: Read posts covering the Latest news and activities from Greek Life at the University of Georgia. Keep abreast of the University's Diversity Initiatives, Panhellenic Sorority Recruitment drive, Anti-Hazing policy, and more. The University of Georgia is Georgia's flagship institution for Higher Education.

feeds.title: Campus Classics Blog » The Greek Life
feeds.description: The College Life Blog answers the questions you have had since you started college. Find the answers to Greek and College life in our blog!

feeds.title: Something Greek's Blog
feeds.description: Tips & Tricks to help you get through Sorority recruitment and further fun programs. Get Theme ideas, gift recommendations, and much more in this blog. Something Greek is Fraternity and Sorority Clothing Store selling personalized, made-to-order Greek apparel and top-notch, high-quality Greek merchandise across North America.

feeds.title: Fratty Bear Blog
feeds.description: Get the Best Event Theme Ideas, Philanthropy & Fundraising guides & ideas, Rush Strategies, and many more insights in the Fratty Bear Blog. Fratty Bear is the premier provider of custom apparel and merchandise for Greek Fraternity and Sorority organizations, along with other campus groups.

feeds.title: Fraternity Communication
feeds.description: The Fraternity Communication blog aims to promote positive images of fraternities and sororities and focuses on positive stories about fraternity/sorority life. This blog will also showcase relevant issues, both pro and con, and serve as a resource to the overall Greek community, host institutions, and business-related affiliates.

feeds.title: Huffpost » Greek Life
feeds.description: Our column on Greek Life in colleges covers a diverse range of Sorority topics, news, and different perspectives in a sincere, relatable voice. The HuffPost is a digital newsroom conveying real, hard-hitting stories with a people-first approach from the news, politics, lifestyle, and entertainment sectors.

feeds.title: GreekXperience Blog
feeds.description: From growing colonies to massive powerhouse chapters, GreekXperience helps fraternity and sorority groups of all sizes get better at delivering effortless recruitment and member experiences. Our blog is a powerful resource helping freshmen figure out the right Chapter or Fraternity for them. Explore Frat ideas and facts in the newest posts.
